## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      10 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 7, 2026 - Sep 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Rachel C_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "I've used Forest for years as a pro member, but the recent UI updates have made it almost unusable. I've gone from using Forest every day to barely opening the app, and unless the developers listen to consumer feedback and go back to the way things were, I'll be uninstalling the app. Such a shame, a great app completely ruined!"
            2. _A_Ruiz_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "After updating to version 5.26.0 the app tells me I have to log in, but I’m not fully logged out either and there’s no way to log out. So I’m blocked without being able to plant together, choose my app allow list or see the daily challenges. I’m very disappointed with how the company is dealing with the app lately. Every time you roll out a new version of the app it comes out incredibly glitchy. I really wished I had left it as it was, use the trees I already have and forget about the new events and stuff"
            3. _Emmiphie_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "Loved the app, have been a user for 5+ years, but this new update made using Forest extremely difficult, annoying and frustrating. The new interface is too complicated and not being able to see the day’s total concentration time erases the whole point of tracking productivity during a work day for me (and many others). Having to click through multiple slow (!) steps to reach the home interface after a study session isn’t only annoyingly slow working, but also resulted in me tapping my phone angrily and therefore suddenly “loosing” a tree and a session log because the app was too slow to register the session being completed but rather saved it as a “failed session” since it more than once made me accidentally click on “back home” instead of “end session”. Using Forest became way less enjoyable and irritating. If you’re not going to change back to an easier and less complicated interface I’ll be using a different tracking and Pomodoro app. Which would be incredibly sad."
<!--/ir-theme-->
